_comment: Advisories reviewed and accepted as known risk. Keyed by GHSA id. Every entry needs a reason and an expires date (YYYY-MM-DD) so acceptance is revisited rather than becoming permanent. An expired entry is a hard failure, not a silent pass — renew it deliberately or fix the advisory. Consumed by scripts/quality/audit-check.ts.

exceptions.reason: No upstream fix exists: 0.6.0 is the latest release and is still affected, so npm's only offered remedy is a downgrade to 0.5.8 (giving up ~10 releases of fixes for a moderate issue). Exposure is limited — adm-zip is a devDependency and an optional peer dependency, so it is never installed for package consumers; ./sde only reads entries from it (SdeDataProvider.fromZip), and the vulnerable extractAllTo call is reached only from scripts/sde/sde-ingest.ts, a maintainer-run script operating on the official CCP SDE archive fetched over HTTPS.

No upstream fix exists: braces 3.0.3 is the latest release and every version is affected. It reaches this repo only through tsd 0.33.0 (the latest) -> globby 11 -> fast-glob -> micromatch, a devDependency that is never installed for package consumers. The only input it expands is the fixed pattern in the test:types script ('tests/typetests/*.test-d.ts'), so no attacker-controlled pattern reaches it. Revisit when braces or tsd ships a fix.
